name: cards
description: Very basic card container with a rounded, bordered surface. Only variation is padding size (8px or 16px). Serves as the base primitive for all card-style elements; consumers pass arbitrary children. TODO: no interactive/behavioral semantics observed in Figma — radixPrimitive inferred from DS convention (Slot for asChild support), not from an explicit Radix pattern in the source.

anatomy.notes: Rounded bordered surface; only anatomy layer. The Figma 'ContentExemple'/'Content' children are illustrative demo content used to show usage, not part of the reusable card anatomy — the real component exposes a generic children slot.

a11y.notes: Purely presentational container. No interactive semantics — consumer content inside determines role/keyboard behavior.
